name: lead-ops
description: Evidence-first, domain-agnostic lead research and outreach pipeline. Walks user through scope → build (discover/enrich/score/audit/export) → execute (outreach). Every lead carries a verifiable fetched-URL evidence record. LLM agents handle judgment; scripts handle data ops; mandatory audit checkpoints prevent silent drift. Pluggable source modules, working surfaces (Sheets/CSV/JSON), and outreach channels.
